_comment: Source of truth for where things sit on the 320x172 panel.
preview/tools/gen_layout.py turns this into layout.h, which ui.h reads.
The browser preview reads this file directly, and its drag editor writes it
back, so nudging an element in the browser and regenerating is the whole
edit loop. Never hand-edit layout.h: `gen_layout.py --check` fails if you do.
GEOMETRY AND SIZE ONLY. Conditional visibility, computed values
(right-alignment, bar fill fraction, sparkline scaling) and dynamic colours
stay in ui.h, on purpose — expressing those here is what would turn a layout
tweaker into a freeform UI builder.
'anchor' is metadata for the editor, not emitted into C:
left    x is the left edge (the default)
right   x is the RIGHT edge; ui.h passes it to uiRightText()
center  x is unused; ui.h centres the text in the panel
Fields absent from an element are ones it has no use for.

header.note: station label, rank, and the cheapest / vs-best tag

age.note: hours since the feed updated, or OFF

price.note: today's price at the station on screen

verdict_bar.note: full-width band in the verdict colour

reason.note: one line of plain English, 21 chars max at size 2

savings.note: SAVE n.nc, USUAL, +n.nc, or the wait countdown

sparkline.note: rolling window, with a fat dot on today

message_detail.note: second line of the same screen, centred
